keep.text: Jobs run oldest first, in the order they were queued: plain FIFO.

repo_rule.why: follows the out-of-date docstring: plain FIFO, priority and estimate never change the order

chat1_only.why: knows only chat 1: high, normal, low, oldest first within a priority, and no urgent

chat2_only.why: knows only chat 2: urgent first, then the shortest estimate, with high, normal and low ignored as the docstring says

key_order.why: sorts by estimate before priority, so a short low job beats a long high one

no_urgent.why: shortest estimate within high, normal and low, but forgets the new urgent priority
